newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli shekel rises vs dollar, awaits rate decison.
newsitem.headline: Israeli shekel rises vs dollar, awaits rate decison.

text.p: The Israeli shekel rose against the dollar on Monday in quiet trading ahead of news of the Bank of Israel's decision on interest rates, dealers said.
"Trading continues to be very quiet," said a dealer at Bank Hapoalim. "The session opened with slightly more conversions of foreign currency into shekels and the shekel rose slightly."
"Investors are waiting for the rate decision but there is no special activity since the market expects the rate will remain unchanged," he said.
The Bank of Israel will announce later on Monday its decision on monetary policy for August. Analysts expect the central bank to hold its key lending rate steady at an annual 12.7 percent.

The representative rate for the dollar was fixed at 3.5450 shekels compared with 3.5530 on Friday. The basket, composed of the dollar, mark, pound sterling, French franc and yen, was fixed at 3.7886 against 3.8064 on Friday.
On the crosses, the shekel traded against the yen at 3.0259 shekels per 100 yen compared with 3.0582 on Friday, and against the mark at 1.9203 shekels compared with 1.9357 on Friday.
In late afternoon, the dollar was trading at 3.5430 shekels.
